# Alchemy Hyperliquid

> Zero-custody REST API, TypeScript SDK, and AI connectors (MCP) for trading on Hyperliquid. Connectors let assistants research, explain, and draft; orders return to Agent.trade for confirmation. Every routed order carries Alchemy's builder code (0.04% perps / 0.05% spot, charged on top of Hyperliquid's own exchange fees).

Key facts:
- Private keys never transit Alchemy's servers. Orders are built server-side, signed client-side, and forwarded to Hyperliquid's /exchange endpoint with signature recovery as the only identity check.
- AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT) can research, explain, and draft trade proposals. Current connector flows do not place trades directly; orders return to Agent.trade for eligibility checks, caps, risk acknowledgement, wallet signature, and explicit confirmation.
- Builder-fee approval is required once per wallet before trading, revocable any time by re-approving at 0%.
- Permissioned connector execution is future roadmap only and is not live today.

## API

- [REST API base](https://alchemy-hl-api.onrender.com): JSON over HTTPS, no API key required for reads
- GET /markets — perps + spot asset metadata (symbol, szDecimals, max leverage, asset index)
- GET /marketStats — mark price, 24h volume, open interest, funding per asset
- GET /markPrice?asset={index} — current mid price
- GET /l2Book?coin={symbol} — order-book snapshot
- GET /balance?user={address} — account value, withdrawable, margin used
- GET /positions?user={address} — open perp positions with per-position PnL
- GET /outcomes — HIP-4 prediction markets (outcome ids, side names, asset ids)
- GET /outcomeOdds?outcome={id} — live implied probabilities from book midpoints
- GET /approval?user={address} — builder-fee approval state
- GET /userFills?user={address} — recent fills
- POST /exchange — two-phase build → sign → send for orders, cancels, leverage, approvals
- POST /preflight — validate an order without signing
- POST /openOrders, POST /orderStatus — open orders (with pre-built cancel actions) and order lifecycle

## AI Connectors (MCP)

- [MCP server](https://alchemy-hl-mcp.onrender.com): streamable-HTTP MCP server for assistant research, explanation, and draft handoff. Connector orders return to Agent.trade for review and confirmation; autonomous or direct connector trade execution is not live.
- [Claude setup](https://alchemy-hl-web.onrender.com/connect/claude): add the MCP URL as a custom connector
- [ChatGPT setup](https://alchemy-hl-web.onrender.com/connect/chatgpt): register the same server via ChatGPT Apps

## Onboarding

- [Account readiness](https://alchemy-hl-web.onrender.com/onboarding): Privy sign-in is supported when configured for email, Google, or existing-wallet login; users without wallets may receive a Privy embedded wallet. Paper mode remains available for local/internal testing without Privy.
- Funding and deposit paths are environment-gated and are not enabled by default. Legacy approval/deposit compatibility screens require explicit flags, live eligibility, and legal/compliance review.
- [Landing & docs](https://alchemy-hl-web.onrender.com/): product overview, connector setup, and safety notes

## Optional

- [Hyperliquid app](https://app.hyperliquid.xyz): the exchange itself — positions, order history, withdrawals
- [Alchemy Discord](https://www.alchemy.com/discord)
- [Alchemy support](https://www.alchemy.com/support)
